subject: English
passage: Maya Lin, an architect and artist, ______ part of the design team that created the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in Washington, D.C., during the early 1980s.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The singular verb "was" agrees in number with the singular subject "Maya Lin."

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because the plural verb "are" doesn't agree in number with the singular subject "Maya Lin."
